---
title: Add Referral
description: >-
  Enable referral codes on sign-up forms, define program duration dates, and
  configure the exact number of reward points both the referrer and referee will
  receive.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1374" height="759" style="width: 1374px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Incentives > Referral > Add Referral Program.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="235" height="169" style="width: 235px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Enable referral codes for your sign-up forms, create a title and description, and set the specific start and end dates.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="543" height="245" style="width: 543px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3. Navigate to Reward tab. Set exactly how many points both referral and referee will receive once they successfully join.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="468" height="236" style="width: 468px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
